title: Alignment Aim Small Miss Small (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, where you aim is where you go
Aim small miss small, never aim slow
Pick a target the size of a coin

[Verse 1]
Club face aimed first at the precise target
Pick a leaf, pick a divot, the precise target
Then feet hips shoulders parallel left of the line
Rail tracks, son, the body line and the ball line

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay a club on the ground at your feet
Parallel to the target line, complete
Use alignment sticks every range session
Good alignment is the silent lesson

[Chorus]
Alignment aim small miss small, son
Club face first, body parallel run
Rail tracks, son, two lines together
Aim for a coin, never the leather

[Verse 2]
Most amateurs aim right of target by ten yards
Then swing left to compensate, slice the cards
Good alignment is the foundation of repeat
Aim where you mean, son, end the deceit

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, walk behind the ball every shot
See the line from there, then take your spot
Intermediate target two feet in front
Aim through that, son, the smaller stunt

[Chorus]
Alignment aim small miss small, son
Club face first, body parallel run
Rail tracks, son, two lines together
Aim for a coin, never the leather

[Outro]
Aim small, miss small
Intermediate target, two foot wall
Rail tracks parallel left
Thats my boy, no deft
